cues.text: Occupancy, the rent roll, the forecast, why deals are lost and unpaid invoices, on one page, ready to print or export.
Reports gathers the numbers that matter for leasing on one page, always up to date.
At the top, the headline figures: occupancy, contracted rent, the average lease length left, the pipeline, the win rate and overdue rent.
Occupancy by level shows how full each floor is, by area.
The rent roll lists every lease with its rent, area and end date. Download it as a spreadsheet from its corner.
The forecast shows the rent expected in the months ahead from the leases already signed.
Why deals are lost counts the reasons given when a lead is closed as lost.
Receivables aging shows how old the unpaid invoices are, so the oldest are chased first.
Leases ending within a year, so renewals start in good time.
Export the leads, units, rent roll or invoices for your own analysis.
Or print the whole page for a meeting.
